SSL/TLS

1. Why SSL/TLS?
  • By default, all Ignite communication is unencrypted;
  • SSL/TLS encrypts data in transit between nodes and between clients and servers;
  • Essential for production deployments, especially when traffic crosses untrusted networks;
2. Enabling SSL for Node-to-Node Communication
  • Create a keystore and truststore, then configure: 
    SslContextFactory sslFactory = new SslContextFactory();
sslFactory.setKeyStoreFilePath("/path/to/keystore.jks");
sslFactory.setKeyStorePassword("keystorePass".toCharArray());
sslFactory.setTrustStoreFilePath("/path/to/truststore.jks");
sslFactory.setTrustStorePassword("truststorePass".toCharArray());

IgniteConfiguration cfg = new IgniteConfiguration();
cfg.setSslContextFactory(sslFactory);
  • All nodes must have SSL configured — a non-SSL node cannot join an SSL-enabled cluster;
3. Enabling SSL for Thin Clients
  • Configure the thin client connector on the server: 
    ClientConnectorConfiguration connCfg = new ClientConnectorConfiguration();
connCfg.setSslEnabled(true);
connCfg.setSslClientAuth(true); // require client certificates

cfg.setClientConnectorConfiguration(connCfg);
  • Configure the thin client: 
    ClientConfiguration clientCfg = new ClientConfiguration()
    .setAddresses("host:10800")
    .setSslMode(SslMode.REQUIRED)
    .setSslClientCertificateKeyStorePath("/path/to/client-keystore.jks")
    .setSslClientCertificateKeyStorePassword("clientKeystorePass")
    .setSslTrustCertificateKeyStorePath("/path/to/truststore.jks")
    .setSslTrustCertificateKeyStorePassword("truststorePass");
4. SSL for JDBC
  • Pass SSL parameters in the JDBC URL: 
    String url = "jdbc:ignite:thin://host:10800?" +
    "sslMode=require" +
    "&sslClientCertificateKeyStoreUrl=/path/to/keystore.jks" +
    "&sslClientCertificateKeyStorePassword=pass" +
    "&sslTrustCertificateKeyStoreUrl=/path/to/truststore.jks" +
    "&sslTrustCertificateKeyStorePassword=pass";
5. Generating Keystores
  • # Generate a keystore with a self-signed certificate
keytool -genkeypair -alias ignite \
    -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
    -validity 365 \
    -keystore keystore.jks \
    -storepass changeit

# Export the certificate
keytool -exportcert -alias ignite \
    -keystore keystore.jks \
    -storepass changeit \
    -file ignite.cer

# Import into truststore
keytool -importcert -alias ignite \
    -keystore truststore.jks \
    -storepass changeit \
    -file ignite.cer \
    -noprompt
  • For production, use certificates signed by a CA instead of self-signed;
